title: Request
description: One request from the host to the plugin. Every request carries an id: notifications and batching are not part of the mechanism. The params schema belongs to the profile; this envelope constrains only the envelope fields. The envelope is open, so a profile may declare fields beside these and checks them in its own schema.

id.description: Assigned by the host. The host never assigns 0, because 0 is the id a plugin uses for a refusal whose request id it could not determine.
